focused_native_memory.program:
require "strscan"
text = "a" * (8 * 1024 * 1024 - 1) + "z"
scanner = StringScanner.new(text)
sum = 0
24.times do |index|
  scanner.reset
  sum += case index % 3
         when 0 then scanner.exist?(/z/)
         when 1 then scanner.skip_until(/z/)
         else scanner.search_full(/z/, false, false)
         end
end
p [text.bytesize, sum, scanner.pos, scanner.matched]
focused_native_memory.wrapper:
import json, os, platform, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
directory = Path(sys.argv[1])
with (directory/'stdout').open('wb') as stdout, (directory/'stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
    process = subprocess.Popen(sys.argv[2:], stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
    pid, status, usage = os.wait4(process.pid, 0)
    code = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
    process.returncode = code
    (directory/'native.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(exit=code, maxrss_kb=usage.ru_maxrss / (1024 if platform.system() == 'Darwin' else 1),
        user_seconds=usage.ru_utime, system_seconds=usage.ru_stime))+'\n')
sys.exit(code if code >= 0 else 128-code)
